note: Defects observed by a human running each artifact, plus what the code shows. Nothing was fixed: repairing a one-shot artifact destroys the measurement it represents.

pelican__q4-0-kv-daily-profile__s42.svg.what: Pelican's legs reach the pedals but then extend upward past the top of the viewBox; the figure never terminates.
Static by design - the benchmark asks for a still SVG, not an animation.

flappy__q4-0-kv-daily-profile__s42.html.what: Difficulty tuning makes the first gap effectively unpassable: PIPE_SPACING is 220px on a canvas capped at 440px, so two pipes are always on screen with 154px of clear air between them.
Frame-rate independence is plumbed but dead. loop() computes dt = (t-last)/16.667, clamps it, and passes it to update(dt) - which never multiplies by it. Physics runs per-frame, not per-second.
flappy__q4-0-kv-daily-profile__s42.html.evidence: code: p.x -= PIPE_SPEED; bird.vy += GRAVITY; bird.y += bird.vy;
flappy__q4-0-kv-daily-profile__s42.html.impact: Harmless on the 60Hz display it was tested on; a 144Hz monitor runs the game 2.4x too fast.

mandelbrot__q4-0-kv-daily-profile__s42.h.what: HiDPI mismatch: createImageData(W,H) allocates in CSS pixels while the canvas backing store is W*DPR x H*DPR. putImageData ignores the current transform and writes in device pixels, so on a DPR=2 display the image lands in the top-left quarter and the rest stays blank.
mandelbrot__q4-0-kv-daily-profile__s42.h.evidence: code: canvas.width = W*DPR (line 265) vs img = ctx.createImageData(W,H) (line 270)

solar__q4-0-kv-daily-profile__s42.html.what: Orbital periods verified against real values: all eight planets match to three decimal places, 0% deviation relative to Earth.
